name: EEMW Monday Night WARS, 29 April 1996

matches.finish: Doom Boy pins Gary Quick after putting a table on top of him and dropping onto it from the top rope, then rolling him back into the ring for the cover.

notes: The league's own founding four-person roster is named at the top of the broadcast: BLAZE (self-declared EEMW World Champion), Doom Boy, Mad Dog Max Smith, and Gary Quick. The broadcast itself introduces DQ as a new house term for disqualification.
